reason: The free sample of 15 companies costs me nothing, and if it looks right, EUR 1,500 up front with the rest only after 5 real meetings is a bounded bet. Worst case is EUR 600 a meeting with a decision-maker, which is still cheaper than my trade fair stand, and the logistics client with 45 meetings is the case I care about.
objection: Meetings are not clients. In logistics a decision-maker taking a call does not mean they move freight to us, and I have no idea how many of those 45 meetings turned into contracts. I also want to know who decides what counts as 'qualified' if the person turns out to be just curious.
would_change_my_mind: If the past logistics client tells me the meetings were tyre-kickers who never signed, or if the 15 sample companies are names I already know or the wrong size, I walk away.
